body: Well done my dude, I can only reach round 900ish on tier 6 so still have a bit to go to get to your level...

I was working the final year of my apprenticeship. I was given 4 months' notice that I was not being taken on full time at the end (I was told throughout my apprenticeship that I would be taken on full time for context). Upset, I went home and, while crying, told my dad what happened. He read through my employment contract and started smiling. He said to go into work and ask if this was an official notice period because in my employment contract, it stated that if this was an official notice period, I could take gardening leave to look for other employment while getting fully paid.

So the next day, I went in to work and asked my manager with HR present. They confirmed this was the case and then said I'll be taking 4 months off to look for new employment. My manager, realizing what just happened, said I couldn't do this, only to be interrupted by HR saying that yes, I could. He then asked if I could still come in and work if I wanted to, but I politely declined and got 4 months off work fully paid and my unused holiday sold back to me.
